d: We are pleased to announce that Nokhbat Segadty Trading Company has an open position for a Sales Specialist within our Sales Department.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in direct sales or retail.
Strong communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.
Ability to achieve sales targets and work effectively within a team.
Familiarity with Point of Sale (POS) systems.
Fluency in Arabic and a suitable level of English.
r: Welcome customers, identify their needs, and recommend suitable products.
Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to overall showroom performance.
Follow up with potential customers and convert sales opportunities into successful transactions.
Promote company products, offers, and additional sales opportunities.
Process sales transactions and issue accurate invoices.
Maintain excellent customer service and showroom standards.
Identify potential wholesale and project sales opportunities and refer them to the responsible team.
x: Employees interested in applying or referring qualified candidates are encouraged to contact the Human Resources Department and submit an updated CV.
We look forward to welcoming talented and motivated individuals to our Sales Team.
